keyboard.description: Moves the crop selection upward by the configured nudge step. Hold Shift for the `nudgeStepShift` value or Ctrl/Cmd for `nudgeStepCtrl`.
Moves the crop selection downward by the configured nudge step. Hold Shift for the `nudgeStepShift` value or Ctrl/Cmd for `nudgeStepCtrl`.
Moves the crop selection to the left by the configured nudge step. Hold Shift for the `nudgeStepShift` value or Ctrl/Cmd for `nudgeStepCtrl`.
Moves the crop selection to the right by the configured nudge step. Hold Shift for the `nudgeStepShift` value or Ctrl/Cmd for `nudgeStepCtrl`.
Resizes the crop vertically from the bottom handle, reducing the height. Hold Shift or Ctrl/Cmd for the larger nudge steps.
Resizes the crop vertically from the bottom handle, increasing the height. Hold Shift or Ctrl/Cmd for the larger nudge steps.
Resizes the crop horizontally from the right handle, reducing the width. Hold Shift or Ctrl/Cmd for the larger nudge steps.
Resizes the crop horizontally from the right handle, increasing the width. Hold Shift or Ctrl/Cmd for the larger nudge steps.
Zooms in on the image. The `=` key performs the same action on keyboards where both symbols share a key.
Zooms out of the image. The `_` key performs the same action on keyboards where both symbols share a key.

zoom.description: The current zoom level of the image.

rotation.description: The current rotation of the image in degrees.

flip.description: The current flip state of the image.

crop.description: The current crop area rectangle in viewport coordinates.

offset.description: The current offset (pan position) of the image.

naturalSize.description: The natural (original) size of the image.

viewportRect.description: The viewport rectangle dimensions and position.

dragging.description: Whether the crop area is currently being dragged.

panning.description: Whether the image is currently being panned.

setZoom.description: Function to set the zoom level of the image.

zoomBy.description: Function to zoom the image by a relative amount.

setRotation.description: Function to set the rotation of the image.

rotateBy.description: Function to rotate the image by a relative amount in degrees.

setFlip.description: Function to set the flip state of the image.

flipHorizontally.description: Function to flip the image horizontally. Pass a boolean to set explicitly or omit to toggle.

flipVertically.description: Function to flip the image vertically. Pass a boolean to set explicitly or omit to toggle.

resize.description: Function to resize the crop area from a handle programmatically.

reset.description: Function to reset the cropper to its initial state.

getCroppedImage.description:
Function to get the cropped image with all transformations applied.
Returns a Promise that resolves to either a Blob or data URL.

getCropData.description:
Function to get the crop geometry in natural image pixels.
The rect is axis-aligned; `corners` preserves the exact source quad.

ids.description: The ids of the image cropper elements

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identify accessibility elements and their states.

initialCrop.description:
The initial rectangle of the crop area.
If not provided, a smart default will be computed based on viewport size and aspect ratio.

minWidth.description: The minimum width of the crop area

minHeight.description: The minimum height of the crop area

maxWidth.description: The maximum width of the crop area

maxHeight.description: The maximum height of the crop area

aspectRatio.description:
The aspect ratio to maintain for the crop area (width / height).
For example, an aspect ratio of 16 / 9 will maintain a width to height ratio of 16:9.
If not provided, the crop area can be freely resized.

cropShape.description: The shape of the crop area.

zoom.description: The controlled zoom level of the image.

rotation.description: The controlled rotation of the image in degrees (0 - 360).

flip.description: The controlled flip state of the image.

defaultZoom.description: The initial zoom factor to apply to the image.

defaultRotation.description: The initial rotation to apply to the image in degrees.

defaultFlip.description: The initial flip state to apply to the image.

zoomStep.description: The amount of zoom applied per wheel step.

nudgeStep.description: The base nudge step for keyboard arrow keys (in pixels).

nudgeStepShift.description: The nudge step when Shift key is held (in pixels).

nudgeStepCtrl.description: The nudge step when Ctrl/Cmd key is held (in pixels).

onZoomChange.description: Callback fired when the zoom level changes.

onRotationChange.description: Callback fired when the rotation changes.

onFlipChange.description: Callback fired when the flip state changes.

onCropChange.description: Callback fired when the crop area changes.

fixedCropArea.description: Whether the crop area is fixed in size and position.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

Selection.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

Grid.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state
